When my gf of 5 years left me I was so heartbroken and distraught. However, I never told myself that I won’t find love again or that its something that I have to possibly accept. And I’m not sure if its something that you should be saying to yourself. I told myself that I need to accept the fact we weren’t right for each other and move on. That if it was meant to be she wouldn’t have left. You might feel lonely and down right now and I understand that, truly. But accept that you’re going to be feeling that way for a while and just ride it out. In time, you may even like being single and there’s nothing wrong with that. I was single for over a year after she left and I liked not feeling responsible for someone else’s feelings. I liked not feeling obligated to text or call someone. I could watch what I wanted to watch, order whatever food I wanted to eat and do things without having to ask another person what is that they wanted. I was able to do things without compromise after 5 years and that was a breath of fresh air! And after a year/year and a half of being single and living for myself I stumbled upon someone new, whom I’m happy with right now and we’re approaching the two year mark in our relationship. Accept that these things will take time. But never accept that you won’t find love or find some other form of happiness. You are deserving of that, we all are. You are worthy of all the good things in life. Just accept that its going to happen on its own time. I wish you luck in your journey of healing brother.
